translations.translation: For skin tired by daily irritation and dryness, low-molecular-weight collagen and hyaluronic acid absorb layer by layer, comfortably filling skin from within.
When used right after cleansing while skin is still damp, active ingredients settle deeper and hydration lasts all day.
Leaves a fresh, non-sticky finish while keeping inner tightness at bay, so it can be used effortlessly before makeup.
A bouncy, skin-hugging texture for makeup-ready skin.
Dual moisturizing design that keeps skin fresh on the surface and hydrated within.
Gently absorbs into sensitive skin that becomes unsettled during seasonal transitions.
Upon application, a thin moisturizing barrier forms on skin to help prevent moisture loss.
The Centella asiatica extract used in this product is refined from Madagascar-sourced ingredients by low-temperature extraction to minimize loss of active ingredients.
We recommend applying a small amount to the inner side of your hand before use, checking for any unusual reaction, then applying to the face.
This ad copy is based on individual usage experiences and does not guarantee the same results for all users.
